speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old female. The patient reports a 1-month history of episodic cough and shortness of breath. The cough is nonproductive and worsens when climbing stairs and at night. She experienced fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma (likely triggered by a prior respiratory infection).

The patient reports a one-month history of episodic cough and shortness of breath that worsens with exertion and at night, alongside a recent history of fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion. Given the normal blood work and the classic pattern of nocturnal and exertional symptoms, this strongly suggests an asthmatic response or post-infectious airway hyperreactivity.
